evidence.title: GitHub - travisvn/awesome-claude-skills: A curated list of awesome Claude Skills, resources, and tools

name: Awesome Claude Skills
summary: Curated list of official and community Claude Skills, with guides on creating, securing and using them.
description: A curated list of Claude Skills, resources and tools: Anthropic's official document, design and development skills, community collections such as obra/superpowers, individual community skills and tools. It also explains how skills load, how to create and share one, when to use skills versus prompts, MCP or subagents, plus security guidance, tutorials and an FAQ.
contains: official Anthropic skills: docx, pdf, pptx, xlsx, canvas-design, frontend-design, mcp-builder, skill-creator
community skills: collections (obra/superpowers) and individual skills such as playwright, d3.js and security skills
guides: creating your first skill, tutorials, security and best practices, FAQ, troubleshooting
